description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useTypedQuery' for managing URL query parameters with schema validation using zod. It includes utility functions for parsing query arrays, updating, removing, and managing URL query parameters in a Next.js application.

methods.name: useTypedQuery
methods.description: A React hook that provides typed access and manipulation of URL query parameters based on a provided zod schema.

methods.name: queryNumberArray
methods.description: Transforms input into a zod array of numbers, accepting string, number, or array of numbers.

methods.name: queryStringArray
methods.description: Transforms input into a zod array of strings, accepting comma-separated string or string array.
